key_facts: Sports piracy in the UK has become widespread: according to Ampere Analysis, around half of sports fans admit to using 'alternative' means to watch paywalled content, with over 70% of 18-34 year olds admitting to doing so regularly.

In summer 2025 authorities intensified enforcement: a Lancashire man was jailed for six and a half years for an illegal streaming service with almost £1m in illicit profits, a Pembrokeshire postman was jailed for over three years for selling illegal subscriptions to nearly 2,000 people, and several pubs were fined for illegally screening matches.
The Premier League's most recent domestic rights deal sold for £6.7bn over four years, with almost as much again from foreign rights.

The 2026 Champions League final went behind a UK paywall for the first time in over 30 years (minimum £4.99); research for the Guardian estimated 3.7 million IP addresses accessed illegal streams versus around 7 million who watched legally.
importance_reason: Структурная тема для медиаиндустрии и прав на спортивный контент; значимого рыночного шока не описано, но влияет на оценку доходов вещателей.
market_link: Рост пиратства и падение подписной базы может давить на доходы вещателей спортивных прав (Sky, TNT Sports) и, через них, на стоимость будущих тендеров лиги.

key_facts: Chancellor John Healey said a third runway at Heathrow Airport "has always been a case for growth", and that airport expansion has been "a big part of jobs and growth" in recent decades; he spoke at the IMF in Bangkok.

Prime Minister Andy Burnham declined to say whether he backs the expansion, telling the BBC last month it was "a matter for London and Londoners"; the consultation on the National Policy Statement is closed and the Department for Transport is "considering the appropriate next steps".

Heathrow CEO Thomas Woldbye called not building a third runway a "huge missed opportunity" and said the consortium needs explicit government backing before the end of the year; the project has an estimated price tag of £33bn, with the runway previously scheduled to open by 2035 but now possibly delayed to 2039, and flights could rise from a 480,000 annual cap to 720,000.
importance_reason: Значимый инфраструктурный и политический сигнал по проекту на £33bn, но без решения правительства и без прямого рыночного шока.
market_link: Решение по третьей ВПП может повлиять на инвестиционные ожидания по авиасектору, строительству и инфраструктуре Великобритании; эффект на рынки прямой не очевиден.

key_facts: David Mummery, an engineer, developed the Swimmer Turbine, a 50kw small-scale tidal energy generator anchored to the sea floor, which can generate enough electricity to power about 30 homes.

Mummery's company, Flex Marine Power, was founded in 2011; he began river tests in the early 2010s in a secret Highland location, and a prototype was trialled in 2015 on the island of Luing in the Firth of Lorn near Oban, securing the company's first major investment the following year.

The Swimmer Turbine is ultra compact and low cost compared to large Scottish tidal projects such as MeyGen (four 1.5MW turbines in the Pentland Firth) and Orbital O2 (2MW floating turbine at Fall of Warness, Orkney), and is designed to be built and installed by local fishermen and workers.
The article recounts the history of the Pelamis P2 wave energy machine in Orkney, which went into administration in 2014; the article is a feature piece and does not report a new market event.
importance_reason: Феатурная история о технологии и предпринимателе без новой рыночной привязки и без конкретного решения или события с измеримым эффектом.
